arguments.message:
You can trim your own notification volume right in your profile:
1. Open **Profile → Notifications**.
2. Turn off the types you don’t need – you can disable mentions, status‑change and digest emails individually.
3. Keep **Assignment** notifications on if you only want alerts about items assigned to you.
These changes take effect immediately and only affect your account; no admin changes are required. Once you save, you should stop receiving the irrelevant emails.
